Sam: Quick customer ask: phased EU+APAC rollout but with an "AB stoplight" and strong token-shielding. Need a short ops-ready spec.
Ivy: Proposed flow: shadow -> micro-canary -> AB-econ with a stoplight (GREEN/YELLOW/RED). YELLOW should automatically scale pct down; RED does immediate routing fallback.
Rohan: Safety ladder: 1) auto-route to stable model, 2) regional flag off, 3) global freeze. AUTO step 1 on RED, steps 2-3 manual ops escalation. Use 3 consecutive 5m windows to avoid flapping.
Priya: Ops constraints: APAC peak usage evenings. Schedule APAC slices only 02:00-06:00 UTC or weekend windows. Add per-tenant hourly token caps and per-tenant rate limits.
Dana: Data wants live-eval: 500 sampled responses/hr (mix synthetic+prod). Metrics: p95 latency, error rate, embedding cosine drift, hallucination proxy, token cost. Quality gate: embed_drift > 0.03 OR hallucination_rate > 0.5% -> YELLOW; persist 30m -> RED.
Ivy: Flag schema suggestion: rollout.stoplight.<id> payload: {mode: shadow|canary|ab, stoplight: GREEN|YELLOW|RED, allowed_pct}. Policy objects immutable; changes create new policy id for audit.
Sam: Customer requires enterprise opt-in for first week with CS approval webhook that flips per-account opt-in flag. Also need in-console banner 72h and email 48h before.
Priya: Token-shielding flow: if tenant_hourly_tokens > budget*0.9 -> throttle to quantized-variant for 10m; if still >0.95 after 10m -> serve cached-limited response; eventual deny only as last resort. Log each step with tenant id.
Rohan: Hysteresis: after any auto-fallback, lock re-enable for 10m and require 3 clean windows. All fallback events must post to #oncall-rollouts with correlation id. rollout-bot should execute step 1 automatically.
Dana: AB analysis rules: compute paired A/B p-value for embedding-based quality and cost-per-token. Require p < 0.05 and cost delta < 10% to go GREEN. Produce short exec report post-canary.
Ivy: Contract tests: function-calling and streaming fallback must roundtrip on stable model. Add smoke endpoint: POST /internal/test/roundtrip with representative payloads.
rollout-bot: Canary started: id=stoplight-2026-03 slice=eu-small pct=1 start=1789997777
Sam: Draft launch checklist:
- Shadow run 72h no regressions on eval set
- Micro-canaries (EU small+medium) 24h no stoplight escalations
- AB-econ p < 0.05 AND cost delta < 10% for 48h
- Ops runbook + CS opt-ins done
Ivy: Timeline: flags+policy engine (2 sprints), data harness (1 sprint), internal shadow 1 week, micro-canary next sprint.
Sam: Please add blockers to the doc by EOD Friday. We'll lock stoplight thresholds Monday 10am UTC. Thanks! :rocket:
